title: Wedding Day & Guest Planning Worksheets
subtitle: Practical pages for decisions, hand-offs and details that deserve more than a cell

pages.title: Guest-list final review
pages.intro: Use this page before submitting the final count. Keep personal information in the workbook or a suitably private location, and share only the details a supplier needs.
checks: Confirm invited, replied and attending counts separately
Check plus-one names and children against the invitation
Ask guests directly about dietary and access needs
Confirm the venue deadline and meal format
Assign one person to submit and verify the final count
fields: Dietary or access notes to share

pages.title: Vendor proposal comparison
pages.intro: Compare suppliers against the same brief. Check what is included, what is optional and which terms are in the signed agreement before choosing.
checks: Compare the same date, hours, location and scope
Separate base fee, options, travel and tax
Check cancellation, rescheduling and overtime terms
Confirm the named day-of contact
Save the proposal and contract together

pages.title: Payment milestone and receipt check
pages.intro: Use the contract as the source of truth for payment schedules. This worksheet helps you spot upcoming actions; it is not financial or legal advice.
checks: List each instalment separately
Distinguish retainer, deposit and final balance
Set a reminder before each due date
Save the receipt or transaction reference
Confirm any changed terms in writing

pages.title: Wedding-day run sheet hand-off
pages.intro: Start with fixed venue and ceremony times, then add realistic travel and setup buffers. Give each supplier the version relevant to their role.
checks: Confirm venue access and setup window
List key transitions and travel times
Name an owner for each hand-off
Share the current schedule with relevant vendors
Leave space to eat, greet guests and pause

pages.title: Small contingency and contact plan
pages.intro: Plan for a few plausible disruptions without trying to control every possibility. Use the venue's official procedures for safety and weather decisions.
checks: Identify the venue contact and on-site lead
Agree who handles vendor delays
Know the venue's weather decision point
Share emergency contacts with named helpers
Decide which issues require the couple's input
fields: Decision that must come to the couple
